decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher builds directly on the firm's core knowledge of post-press finishing equipment, so its distributor know-how lets it interpret customer feedback and keep supporting the product.
The UV spot varnishing system had a showcased German premiere with a customer, which shows the firm recognises its value and can assimilate it through its established Duplo partnership.
The sheet preparation module complements the firm's existing finishing lines, but its weaker visibility gives somewhat more uncertainty about results.
The B2 multifinisher extends the firm's well-understood multifinishing portfolio and was prominently launched, so it fits the firm's absorptive capacity.
The hybrid saddle stitcher relies on related binding knowledge the firm already holds as a specialised finishing equipment distributor.
The folding add-on unit already has a documented customer installation with the Multigraf combination, giving the firm interpretable early results to learn from.
